yattāvaduktam--kāraṇayorvaṃśadalayorvibhāgo vibhāgamabhinirvartayiṣyan vaṃśavināśamapekṣate ityādi; tatra aṅgulyavayave chedakriyātaḥ avayavāntarādvibhāgāt saṃyogavināśe sati yadi avayavinaḥ śarīrasya vināśaḥ tarhi tadavayavachedanakarmādimātrata eva śarīrasya nāśe tadguṇānāṃ nāśāt tadavayavyupalambhavikalatadārambhakapādādyavayavānāmeva upalambhaḥ syāt
na caivam, tacchedanāt prāk paścāt tatsamakālaṃ ca tadevedaṃ śarīram iti pratīteḥ
itarathā chinnāṅgulirapi sa evāyaṃmadīyaḥ putraḥ ityādi vyavahāravilopaprasaṅgaḥ
nanu ca ekāvayavasaṃyogavināśe pūrvadravyanivṛttau punaḥ avasthitasaṃyogebhyo'vayavebhyo anyadravyamupajāyate ato'yamadoṣa iti cet; kośapānaireva kevalamartho'yaṃ pratyeyaḥ, na pratīteḥ, sarvadaikatvapratītyupalambhāt
bhrānteyamekatvapratītiriti cet; na; bādhakābhāvāt
atha pūrvadravyavināśe dravyāntarotpattireva bādhiketi cet; sā kutaḥ siddhā ? tatpratītervibhramāccet; anyonyasaṃśrayaḥ--siddhāyāṃ dravyāntarotpattau tatpratītervibhramaḥ, tasmācca tatsiddhiriti
yadi ca, sarvadā śarīrasya ekatve pratīyamāne ekāvayavasaṃyogavināśe pūrvadravyanivṛttau punaḥ avasthitasaṃyogebhyo'vayavebhyo'nyadravyamupajāyate itīṣyate; tarhi saha krameṇa ca varaṃ paramāṇava eva abhyupagatāḥ, tathā ca avayavyādisādhanaprayāsād bhavanto mucyeran

api ca, yadi nāma ekāvayavasaṃyogavināśaḥ kimāyātaṃ yena tato bhinnasya avayavino vināśaḥ atiprasaṅgāt ? na hyavaśyaṃ kāraṇanāśād utpannaṃ kāryaṃ naśyati atrapariṇāmikāraṇavināśaḥ

ekasmāt karmaṇaḥ kathamaneko vibhāga iti cet ? katham ākāśakāladigātmādibhyo yugapat tasya bahavo vibhāgāḥ tairvā saṃyogāḥ, yenedam saṃyogavibhāgānāṃ karma vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1

yadyayamekāntaḥ antarbahirvā viruddhadharmādhyāse naikatvaṃ syāditi kathaṃ bahirarthavibhramacetasāṃ svasaṃvedanam ? kasyacit pramāṇatadābhāsasvabhāvasāṅkarye cittasya kathaṃ pratibhāsabhedādinaikatvaṃ nirākriyeta ? savikalpakanirvikalpayoḥ kathañcidekatve sukhaduḥkhayorapi tathaiva kathanna bhavet ? tadayamekāntamavalambya bahirantarmukhanirbhāsavibhrametaravikalpetaracetaḥsvabhāvamanekāntanāntarīyakaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ taddveṣī tatkārī ceti upekṣāmarhati
atra dvau pratibhāsaśabdau tatra ādyaḥ saṃvedanavācī anyo viṣayākāravācī
tato'yamarthaḥ saṃpadyate--pratibhāsasya saṃvedanasya aikyaniyame niraṃśatvaniyame aṅgīkriyamāṇe dhīḥ buddhiḥ ekaiva na syāt kintu anekā syāt
kiṃ kurvatī ? dadhatī

10 iti anabhilāpinīṃ pratibhāsapratītiṃ timirāśubhramaṇanauyānasaṃkṣobhādyāhitavibhramām ityabhilāpinīṃ vibhrāṇā dhīḥ ekaiva na syād anekaiva syāditi
tathāhi--bahirarthavibhramacetasām anyaiva svasaṃvedanāt keśoṇḍukādipratītiḥ ekasyā bhrāntetarākāradvayā'yogāt
na ca sā jñānarūpā asti; atiprasaṅgāt
taccetaḥsvasaṃvedanena tajjñāne nāsya vibhramaḥ tadākārānukaraṇāt, nīlākārānukaraṇe nīlatāvat
tadākārasya tato bhede sa eva doṣaḥ anavasthā ca
atadākārānukaraṇe na tena tajjñānam, itarathā nirākāradarśanam
tasyāḥ svasaṃvedanābhyupagame ekasya rūpadvayabhayāt svasaṃvedanāt punarapi tatpratītiranyā'bhyupagantavyā
na ca sā'jñātarūpā'sti iti codye tasminneva uttare sa eva doṣaḥ anavasthā ca
tadevaṃ keśoṇḍukādipratīteḥ anupalambhena asattvāt tannivṛttyartham abhrāntagrahaṇaṃ pratyakṣalakṣaṇe kṛtamanarthakam

tatkathaṃbhūtam ? ityatrāha--mano'kṣavikalpānāṃ samānam iti

nanu pratyakṣaprastāve kimarthamaprastutānāṃ manovikalpānāmupādānamiti cet ? dṛṣṭāntārtham
yathā manovikalpānāṃ vitarkā'nugatavyāpakasāmānyagrahaṇapūrvaṃ vyāpyaviśeṣāvāyajñānaṃ tathā akṣavikalpānāmiti
na cāsiddho dṛṣṭāntaḥ; pūrvaṃ manasā sāmānyavyavasāyaḥ, tadanantaraṃ tadviśeṣākāṅkṣaṇam, ataśca puruṣaḥ sthāṇuḥ iti vā viśeṣāvāyajñānam, saugatasyāpi prasiddhametaditi
nanu yadi nāma manovikalpānāṃ vitarkānugatavyāpakasāmānyagrahaṇapūrvaṃ vyāpyaviśeṣāvāyajñānaṃ kimāyātaṃ yena akṣavikalpānāṃ tat syāt ? na hi ekasya dharmo niyamena anyasyāpi, anyathā arkasya kaṭu kimā guḍasya syāditi cet; atrāha--tatra ityādi
tatra dṛṣṭāntetararūpe tadvikalpānāṃ sahanirdeśaḥ indriyārthayoḥ sannikarṣaḥ yogyadeśādisannidhiḥ samayasya avagrahādikālasya niyamena avyabhicāreṇa antarvāsanāprabodham antarvāsanā manovikalpavāsanā tasyāḥ prabodham unmīlanaṃ spaṣṭayati viśadaṃ karoti iti hetoḥ teṣāṃ tatsamānam iti

kathaṃ tadavagṛhyate ? ityāha--tadviśeṣehayā iti

nanu yadi nāma tadbalāt tadvikalpotpattiḥ tathāpi na svalakṣaṇopalakṣaṇaṃ niyamābhāvāditi cet; atrāha--tad ityādi

nanu yaduktam--smṛtiḥ pramāṇam avisaṃvādāt pratyakṣavat iti; tanna sāram; dṛṣṭānte arthasārūpyāt prāmāṇyasiddheḥ smṛtau tadabhāvāditi cet; atrāha--pratyakṣasyāpi ityādi

yāvān ityādinā kārikārthamāha--yāvān kaścid dhūmavān pradeśaḥ, upalakṣaṇametat dhānu kālo'pi gṛhyate sa pradeśādiḥ sarvo'pi na kevalaṃ kaścideva agnimān ityevaṃ vyāptau asiddhāyāṃ satyāṃ anumeyasya aprasiddhasya yā pratipattiḥ tasyā anupapatteḥ anumāna smṛtyantarād aliṅgajāt smaraṇāt na viśeṣyeta na bhidyeta
etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā ananubhūte na smṛtyantaram atiprasaṅgāt tathā vyāpyatvenāniścitāt liṅgāt vyāpakatvenāniścitasyānumeyasya pratipattirapi na yuktā, anyathā bhūmigṛhavardhitasya akasmād dhūmadarśanād agnipratipattiḥ syāt
tavaivaṃ vyāpakatvenāgṛhītasya tataḥ pratipattisaṃbhāvanā, anumānasya smṛtiviśeṣatvāt ata evoktam--smṛtyantarāt iti, tataḥ tadasattvena na viśeṣyeta iti manyate
tathā yāvān kaścidbhāvaḥ sa sarvaḥ kṣaṇika eva ityevaṃ tasyamasiddhāyāṃ sarvaṃ vācyam
tasyāṃ siddhāyāṃ ko doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--siddhau iti
siddhau niścaye evaṃ vyāpteḥ iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ, anumānaṃ smṛtyantarāt na viśeṣyeta

pramāṇāntaramanyatra tatsaṃjñā'saṃbhavasmṛtiḥ | 1/2
tadvākyāhitasaṃskārasya agoṣu svayaṃ tannāmāsambandhamarthāpattyā upagamyate yathā sāmānyena liṅgaliṅgisambandhapratipattiḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ tatheyamapi pratyabhijñānaṃ pramāṇāntaram, na gavayo'yaṃ tādṛśopalabdheḥ
athavā, ekaviṣāṇi khaṅgaḥ saptaparṇo viṣamacchada ityāhitasaṃskārāṇāṃ punastatpratyakṣadarśināmabhijñānaṃ kinnāma pramāṇaṃ syāt ?
upamānādanyat pramāṇaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt anyatra gavayād anyeṣu mahiṣyādiṣu gavaya iti saṃjñā tatsaṃjñā tasyāḥ asaṃbhavasmṛtiḥ

athā'nutpattidharmakam ākāśavad bandhyāstandhayavat; kathaṃ kādācitkam iti virodhaḥ ? tasmāt kādācitkatvād utpattidharmakamiti bhāvaḥ

yadi punaḥ gaganādivat anādheyā'praheyātmakam; kathaṃ kādācitkam ? atha jātasya punaḥ atiśaya āvānupānetuṃ vāmaśakyata iti tattadātmakamucyate; tadasatya kādācitkatve arthakriyākāritve vā tatra ādheyapraheyātiśayātmakatvaṃ ghaṭādivat punaranumiteḥ pratipadyamānaḥ kena vāryate ?
tathaiva kādācitkamavinaśvaram iti prakriyāvyāvarṇanamātraṃ virodhāt, sarvasya kādā citkasya vinaśvaratvena pratītiḥ ghaṭādivat iti
tathā kādācitkaṃ svavināśahetubhāvāt svaśabdena vināśa vastu parāmṛśyate tasya vināśaḥ svo vināśasya ātmīyo vā vināśaḥ tasya hetoḥ kāraṇasya abhāvāt na vinaśyati iti prakriyāvyāvarṇanamātraṃ virodhāt iti svamatavyādhātāt
yo hi kādācitkatve jagato'pi vināśakāraṇamabhyupagacchati tasya prakṛte kā'kṣamā ? tathā vināśe vā pradhvaṃse vā vināśavastunaḥ iti sambandhaḥ

darśayati
vādajalpayoḥ

yadi tadvacanaṃ jalpaḥ tadanavasānam tanniyamakāraṇasya asādhanādiḥ avacanāditi cet; atrāha— pakṣanirṇayaparyantam iti
pakṣasya vivādagocarārthasya nirṇayaḥ vipratipattiparihāreṇa avasthānaṃ paryanto yasya sa tathoktaḥ tam iti na vādiprativādiguṇadoṣasaṃkīrtanaparyantamiti bhāvaḥ

aparisamāptiḥ
nanu yadi vādisambandhipakṣanirṇayaparyantam iti gṛhyate jalpāpravṛttiḥ, pūrvameva tannirṇaya bhāvāt, svaniścayavad anyasya niścayotpādanāya taddhetuprayogāt, itarathā gopālavat kutastasya jalpe vikāraḥ
etena prāśnikatannirṇayaparyantamiti cintitam siddhāntadvayavedinaḥ iti vacanāt nirjñātobhayapakṣāṇāmeva prāśnikatvāt
pārthivaḥ punaḥ pārthiva iva na sarvaḥ svayaṃ tannirṇayavān tannirṇayaparyantam iti ca duravagāham
nāpi prativāditannirṇayaparyantam ityupapannam; svadurāgamāhitadṛḍhavibhramasya prativādinaḥ pratipadya mānasyāpi tannirṇayayogāt
tanna yuktaṃ pakṣanirṇayaparyantam iti cet; na sundarametat; yataḥ sādhyāvinābhāvisādhanaprayogopanyāsād apahāya prarūḍhamapi vyāmohaṃ prativādinaḥ parapakṣaṃ pratiyantaḥ pratīyante abhimānino'pi, āturā iva paramauṣadham
ye'pi ca kecinna pratiyanti khalamatayaḥ tadapekṣayā tadupanyāsajanitaḥ satyanirṇayo jñātobhayakṛtāntānām anyavacanāt pratipattiḥ jāyate, itarathā janmanasi vādītaraguṇadoṣapratipattiviśvavaidhuryāt kuto nikaṣopalambhasamā natvaṃ yatastadapekṣā syāditi
vādipakṣasya nirṇītatvādityarthaḥ

parārthaṃ mānamākhyātaṃ vākyaṃ tadupacārataḥ

tathāhi--āḍhyo'yaṃ navakambalavattvat ityukte sa prativādī udbhāvayati mā asya nava kambalāḥ kintu ekaḥ ityasiddho heturiti; tatredaṃ cintyate--kiṃ samyak sādhanaprayoge puraḥ sa e tadudbhāvane prativādinaḥ parājayaḥ, viparīte vā ? tatrādyapakṣe svapakṣasiddhyaiva vādī prativādinaṃ vijayate kimanyena ? yadi punaḥ dvirbaddhaṃ subaddhaṃ bhavati iti tadudbhāvanenāpi; tadasatyam; yuktyā nigṛhīte tadvaiphalyāt, viṣopayogamṛte sattomahi tadvyāpādanāya svalpacapeṭādikaṃ yuñjate
kathañcaivaṃ hetvantaraṃ nigrahasthānaṃ na dūṣaṇāntarodbhāvanam iti vibhāgaḥ, yato vādino yugapat jayaparājayau na syātām ? tasmāt navakambalatvādi tihetvarthasya vivakṣitatvāt nāyamasiddho hetuḥ
prakaraṇādi bhiśca anekārtheṣu śabdeṣu niyatārthasaṃpratyayaḥ karttavyaḥ, anyathā sarvaśabdānāmanekārthatvāt sarvo'pi evaṃ hetvādiḥ duṣṭaḥ syāt nāstyatra sītasyaso dhūmaketoḥ--śikhinaḥ ityādi prayo ge'pi tadudbhāvanasaṃbhavāditi
evamasau nivāraṇīyo na tāvatā nigrahaṇīyaḥ, samīcīnasādhanaprayogavaiphalyam anyathā syāditi
bhāve ca sakṛt jayaparājayau vādinaḥ
kiṃ punarevaṃvādinā tadudbhāvanaṃ na karttavyam ? na nigrahabuddhyā prakṛtadoṣāt api tu nivāraṇabuddhyā iti brūmaḥ
anudbhāvane ko doṣaḥ ? na kaścit, yadi hetuṃ samarthayate
nigrahaḥ ityapare; tadasāmpratam; yataḥ prativādiprayuktachalānudbhāvanaṃ vādinaḥ parājayādhikaraṇaṃ yadi sa eva mayā prayuktaṃ chalaṃ kṛpayā nodbhāvitamiti paryanuyojyopekṣaṇāt nigṛhīto'si iti vyavasthāpayet; tarhi tasyaiva tadudbhāvane svayaṃ svadoṣodbhāvanāt
asti vā svabhāvatadudbhāvanāvasthayoḥ viśeṣaḥ ? dṛśyante hi svayam udbhāvitenāpi doṣeṇa nigṛhyamāṇāḥ cauraprabhṛtayaḥ
ko hi svaṃ kaupīnaṃ vivṛṇuyāt iti vacanāt svayaṃ tadudbhāvanāyogācca
atha sabhyāḥ; te tarhi yathā tadanudbhāvanaṃ tasya parājayaṃ vyavasthāpayati tathā samīcīnasādhanavacanaṃ jayamapi vyavasthāpayantu
saha jayetarau syātāmiti cet; jālpikasyaiva ayaṃ doṣo'paro'stu
atha tadanudbhāvanadoṣaiḥ na sādhanasamīcīnatā syāt, sa doṣo'pi mā bhūt; aho madhyasthāḥ prāśnikāḥ yadalpadoṣeṇa mahāguṇamapi sādhanamasamīcīnaṃ manyante, na punaḥ tadguṇena alpadoṣam adoṣam iti
tanna ādyapakṣe samīcīnasādhanaprayogapurassare chalodbhāvane vādī paraṃ vijayata iti

vitanukāraṇasya ityādinā kārikāṃ vyākhyātu śarīrendriyetyādi pūrvamupacati tanvādisaṅgamanubhavatisaṃsāriṇa ityarthaḥ
svayam ātmanāna īśvarādinā, utpattuḥ gatadisaṃbandhitayā jāyamānasya
kiṃbhūtasya ? ityāha--aniṣpannakāyakaraṇasya katham ? na kathañcit, ātmāpayogyayogyaniṣpādanasāmarthyam
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tatparigrāhetyādi
notpattuḥ tanniṣpādanasāmarthyamapi tu tadviparītayoḥ pitroḥ iti cet; atrāha--niṣpannetyādi
maithune tadvyāpārāt
na ca tadeva tatra vyāvṛttiḥ pratimaithunamapatyotpattiprasaṅgāt iti bhāvaḥ
karmmaṇātatra vyāvṛtti riti cetyādi tatkṛtiḥ śarīrendriyādirna saṃbhāvyeta
kutaḥ kasya sā saṃbhāvyata ityāha--pāriśeṣyāt ityādi
prasaktapratiṣedhe anyasiddhiḥ pāriśeṣyaṃ tasmād īśvaraḥ kāraṇam
tathāhi--śarīre tipādikāryaṃ kāraṇāvinābhāvi, tasya ca uktavidhinā nānyat kāraṇam iti pāriśeṣād īśvaraḥ ityevaṃ vaiśeṣikādayaḥ
tattvadūṣakādayaḥ
tattvadūṣaṇamāha--vitanukaraṇasya ityādi
vitanukaraṇasya īśvarasya iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
punariti vitarke
icchayā śarīrādikaraṇaṃ vāñchayā kathaṃ saṃbhāvyeta ? kim ? ityāha--jīvopabhoga ityādi
itarathātathāvidhasya svayamutpattuḥ icchayā tanniṣpattiḥ saṃbhāvyeta
tasyecchā tādṛśī kuto'vagamyate ? īśvarasya kutaḥ ? kāryaniṣpatteḥ; anyatra samānam
janmottarakālaṃ tadicchātaḥ kuto na kāryam ityapi nottaram; īśvarecchāsarveka kāryaniyātaṃ
tatra pramāṇābhā vāhayanivāraḥ saṃbhāvyeta
sakṣadutpanne'pi tato jagatkārye punastasyāmapi tannotpadyate
tatkṛtiḥ
tattvadūṣakādayaḥ iti punarlikhitam

syānmatam--ātmanaḥ śarīrādisambandhakaraṇe na kasyacid icchā asti, satī vā kathaṃ nedānīṃ sarvaiḥ smaryate iti; tanna sāram; yataḥ tasyārthasyamaraṇepyanivāraṇāt asmaraṇaṃ mathāpi viśiṣṭam, sāmarthyam ubhayatra sandigdhamiti manyate
etadevāha— tad ityādi
sa cāsau utpattā vanenā viśeṣād īśvarasyeti
yata eva viśeṣo'ta eva varamīśvaraṇa siṣṭaḥ evaṃ tadārādhanād dharmasiddheḥ iti cet; atrāha--pratiṣiddhaṃ ca ityādi
utpadyate iti utpattā
nanu mama buddhimatkāraṇamātrasiddhyā prayojanam, tatkāraṇam īśvaro bhavatu paro vā pariṇāmyeva iti cet; atrāha--samavāyītyādi
tasya īśvarasya anyasya vā pariṇāmopagame'pi, apiśabdaḥ pakṣāntarasūcakaḥ
kutaḥ tadupagamaḥ ? ityāha--samavāyītyādi
samavāyikāraṇatvaṃ ca sthitvāpravṛttiśca ādiśabdena nimittakāraṇatvādiparigrahaḥ tasya pariṇāmina eva saṃbhavāt iti
tatra dūṣaṇam--pravarttanetyā di
pravartanālakṣaṇā doṣā rāgādayaḥ kathaṃ na syuḥ naiva īśvarasyeti
kiṃbhūtāḥ ? ityatrāha--tajjanmahetavaḥ tacca tanu śarīrendriyādisambandhalakṣaṇaṃ janma tasya hetavaḥ, tasyāpi saṃsāra itarajīvavat syādityarthaḥ
tasya doṣāstitve kiṃ pramāṇamiti cet ? atrāha-- pravarttamānānāṃ jantūnāṃ preraṇā pravarttanā saiva lakṣaṇaṃ cihnaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ
tathāhi--yaḥ paramamiṣṭa karmaṇā yojayati sa rāgādināmave tano yathā dhyāno ? yojayati ca tena paramīśvara iti
rāgādyabhāve'pi tasya tatpravarttanā'virodhādanaikāntiko heturiti cet; atrottaram tanvādikaraṇād ityādi bhaviṣyati
sato'pi tasya rāgādayo na karmasambandhakāraṇaṃ devatāviśeṣatvād yathā mayūrasya viṣaṃ na ramaṇa kāraṇam
ata eva doṣasadbhāvata evaṃ karmasambandhopapatteḥ tajjanmahetavaḥ kathanna syuḥ iti ? anyathā sarvasyāpi tatastatsambandhabhāva iti manyate

nayavi॰ pṛ॰ 279
smartavyatve satyasmaraṇāt yogyānupalabdhinirastasya karturanumānāsaṃbhavāt samākhyāpravacananimittatvāt apauruṣeyā vedā iti

vāśabda ivārthaḥ
anyasya suvarṇāderiva śabdasya anekāntamantareṇa adaḥ tatra mityuktam, apūrvamnyasya pariṇāmitvaṃ siddham ku mā ri la sye va iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ
nanu pariṇāmanityatvaṃ na kūṭasthanityatvam hetuḥ, tasya ca ubhayāsiddhatvāt nāsiddho hetuḥ iti cet; atrāha--pariṇāme'pi pariṇāmanityatve'pyaṅgīkriyamāṇe navākṣarāśerapauruṣeyatvaṃ yuktam apuruṣakartṛkatvam upapannam yena puruṣāśritadoṣābhāvāt svataḥ pramāṇaṃ vedaḥ syāt
kutastanna yuktam ? ityāha--śāstrāntarasyāpi ityādi

na caivam, ato vyabhicārī hetuḥ iti bhāvaḥ
atha durbhaṇatvādimattve sati tannityatvāt iti viśiṣṭo'nyata iti na doṣaḥ; tatrāha— viśeṣābhāvācceti
tadantaraparihāriṇa vede viśeṣasyābhāvāt, aśeṣaviśeṣasya anyatrāpi karaṇasaṃbhavāt
ca ityavadhāraṇe

dūṣaṇāntaramāha--tāvatetyādi
tāvatā karturasmareṇa nityatvamātreṇa pramāṇatve vedasya karttusmartā enanasmata śāstrāntarasyāpi na kevalaṃ vedasya hiraṇyagarbhādivat tataḥ tasyāpi pramāṇatvaṃ bhavediti
anena uttarabhāgo vyākhyātaḥ

tatrānya pakṣadvaye dūṣaṇamāha--varṇānāṃ padānāṃ ca na kvacit pramāṇyaṃ na bhavet, api tu vedavayādāvapi bhavet pratiṣedhadvayena pratyakṣārthagateḥ
nahi loke vede ca varṇapadaḥagnyādibhayatrāviśeṣāt
tṛtīyapakṣe dvaiddhatasaṅketāpekṣāṇām, anyathābhūtānāṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha--saṅketa ityādi
prakṛtavākyarāśeḥ vaidikavākyarāśeḥ ityaṃ prati pauruṣeyavākyarāśiṃ prati na kaścidviśeṣaḥ pramāṇatvetarakṛto na bhedaḥ
kasmin sati ? ityāha--saṅketāt tadarthapratipattau, rāgādimān puruṣaḥ saṅketaṃ kuryāditi tanniyataḥ saṅketa iti manyate
dūṣaṇāntaramāha--prakṛtavākyarāśeḥ pauruṣeyavākyāntaraṃ prati nakaścid viśeṣaḥ
vyaktiḥ sadā sataḥ tadvākyarāśeḥ prakāśanam, na tadarthasya saṅketetyādinā uktatvādasya
pauruṣeyī ca sā vyaktiḥ citi
tayā tadrāśeḥ itaraṃ prati na kaścid viśeṣaḥ
vākyānāṃ pramāṇatvamityatra
dvaitamiti dvau vikalpau vakṣyamāṇau ityarthaḥ
vaidikavākyarāśeḥ

vaidikavākyarāśeḥ

parijñātapadārthasya sarvasyāpi tadvākyarāśiśravaṇo daparopadeśatadarthapratītiḥ syāt, na caiva na ca paṇḍito'pi parakāvyaṃ tadupadeśād yathāvadavagacchati

nanu puruṣāntare vaktṛtvādau sati sarvajñatvamupalabdham, upalabhyate ca tīrthakare'pi vaktṛtvādikamiti tatrāpi tadastu, anyathā nu kṛtakatvādeḥ anityādipratīḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--na hi ityādi

etena rathyāpuruṣādanye sarve puruṣāḥ rāgādimanto baktṛtvādibhyastadvaditi sākalyena rāgādimattvasādhanaṃ pratyuktam
tathā tatsādhane jai mi nyā derapi sādhanānna vedaḥ pramāṇamitarat anyatheti
sarvajñānāṃ yo bhāvaḥ pareṇa iṣyate tatra sandehe anupalambhaḥ sarvānupalabdhirna sidhyati sarvajñānā svaparolambhavān

atha matam--yaḥ sarvaktuḥ bhātmānaṃ parañca paśyati ityucyate; nāsau sarvajñaḥ puruṣatvādibhyo rathyāpuruṣavaditi cet; uktamatra--anyathānupapattirahitatvāt naite hetavaḥ iti

anupalambhaḥ svasya sarvasyavā ? ityādi
nanunavipakṣe'bhāvasiddhyā puruṣatvādayaḥ kvacit sarvajñā vā bhāvaṃ sādhayanti kintu yadvyāyo; nanu sarvajñābhāvasandehe tadvyāptirapi kathaṃ sidhyati ? tayaiva tadasandeha iti cet; anyo'nyasaṃśrayaḥ
tathāhi--siddhānāṃtadvyāptau tadabhāvaḥ sidhyanti tatsiddhau ca sā sidhyati
tadāha--tato'nupalambhasyā'siddhitaḥ syāt tatra sarvajñābhāvasādhane vyāptau vā sarvahetūnāṃ puruṣatvādīnāmanyo'nyasamāśrayaḥ

so'pohaḥ viṣayo yasya śabdajñānasya tattathoktam

apohaviṣayatve'pi

ko'sau ? ityāha--tathāgataprajñaḥ tathāgate sugate prajñā yasya sa tathoktaḥ devānāṃpriyaḥ
yadi vā, tathā tena prakāreṇa gatā dhvastā prajñā yasya iti grāhyam, ata eva devānāṃ priyaḥ

saṃvido jñānasya nīlatayā arthena saha yaḥ na samāno yaśca jaḍetararūpatayā itaraḥ asamānaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tamantareṇa tathā pratyakṣādiprakāreṇa dṛśyaprāpyayorekatvādhyavasāyaprakāreṇa vā pravartamānāsaṃbhavāt vyavahāriṇaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ
pravartamāna saṃsāra, pūrvapāvakādivāsanāta uttarottarapāvakādipratibhāsapravṛttiḥ tasyā'saṃbhavāt

nirastamadvaitam
saṃvido bhavattatpariṇāmo nārthasya iti cet; atrāha--tatsaṃbhave samānapariṇāmasaṃbhave saṃvidaḥ ityanuvarttate bahirapi kinna syāt tatpariṇāmaḥ ?
naiti nirarthakam
jñānaṃ na jaḍam, arthastu jaḍa iti

āyāsādyantādyato vā iti pakṣāntaradyotakaḥ, bhedān cetanetaraviśeṣān abhedaḥ sattāmātraṃ svīkaroti aya bhedasaṃvyavahārān kiṃ na karoti so'bhedaḥ kevalaḥ sakalabhedavikalaḥ
nanu yadi abhedaḥ; bhedavyavahāraḥ tataḥ katham ? anyathā nīlāt pītavyavahāraḥ syāt iti cet; atrāha--nahi abhinnatattvasya ityādi
kutaḥ ? ityatrāha--svapnādau darśanāt
atra ādiśabdena dvicandrādiparigrahaḥ
svapne hi kṛśo'pi sthūlatayā, anyakālādiḥ anyakālāditayā, devadatta eko'pi anekatayā, jāgaraṇe candraḥ tathā sutti kānekatayā pratibhātīti bhāvaḥ
parasyāpi etadastīti darśayannāha--bhedavādino'pi na kevalamabhedavādinaḥ tajñānaṃ bhedavādijñānam; kiṃbhūtam ? niraṃśam, punarapi kiṃbhūtam ? avarṇādyātmakaṃ rūparasādirahitam, rūpādikaṃ sthūlatvādyanekadharmābhinnaṃ na ca niraṃśe tadyuktam
kiṃ karoti ? ityāha--tadvyavahāraṃ bhedavyavahāraṃ prathayatyeva
kiṃbhūtam ? sāṃśamiva varṇādinirbhāsamiva, ca śabdo'trāpi yojyaḥ
ardharātre madhyāhnasvapnadarśanaṃ bhavati
nanu yathā bhedaḥ pratibhāti naivamabhedaḥ, tato'styanayoḥ viśeṣa iti cet; atrāha--tattva ityādi
tattvasya niraṃśātmano yaddarśanaṃ tasya sarvathā sarveṇa pratyakṣādiprakāreṇa svataḥ parataḥ iti vā prakāreṇa anupapatteḥ
kalpanayā tadupapattiḥ, ubhayatrāpi
bhedābhedayoḥ
syānmatam--ta jñānaṃ niraṃśamavarṇādyātmakaṃ tathaiva vyavahāraṃ prathayati iti; tatrāha--tattva ityādi
vyākhyānam tadeva
yadi vā, yadi jñānaṃ sāṃśameva varṇādinirbhāsaṃ vyavahāraṃ prathayati tathaiva taditi tattvam ityādi saugatasya yattasya darśanasya sarvathānupapattervā bhedavādino'pi ityādinā sambandhaḥ
nanu yadi abhedaḥ tarhi jāgraddaśāyāmavisaṃvādoyaḥ pramāṇavyavasthānimittaṃsvapne yaśca visaṃvādo'pramāṇavyavasthākāraṇaṃ tau kathaṃ syātām ? bhede tasyā tāmiti cet; atrāha--saṃvād ityādi
saṃvādāsaṃvādau
kiṃbhūtau ? pramāṇetaranimittabhūtau yathāsaṃkhyena pramāṇāpramāṇahetubhūtau tatra tayoḥ bhedābhedayoḥ syātām
kutaḥ ? ityāha--aviśeṣataḥ vāsaṃnādārḍhyā'dārḍhyabhedataḥ
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt sarvavikalpātītaṃ tattvam
kiṃ tat ? ityāha--sanmātram ityevaṃ saṃgrahanayaḥ
atra yaduktaṃ saugatena dūṣaṇam kathaṃ bahirantaḥ pratibhāsabhede sanmātraṃ tattvam ? tadvibhrame sanmātre kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ iti; tadega tasyāpi samānamiti darśayannāha--saṃvittereva ityādi
bhedavādino bauddhasya vijñaptimātraṃ buddhimātraṃ tattvaṃ yathā saṃgrahavādinaḥ sanmātram
avisaṃvāda-visaṃvādau
bauddhasyāpi
nanu tasya bahirantarvā bhedo'pyasti iti cet; atrāha--saṃvittereva nānyasya bahiriva pratibhāsanāt tato yathā asyā'bāhyamapi bāhyatayā cakāsti tathā parasya abhinnaṃ bhinnatayā iti manyate
abhedavādinaḥ
syānmatam--yathā vijñaptimātraṃ dṛśya na tathā anyaditi cet; atrāha--tad vijñāptimātraṃ punaḥ adṛṣṭaparamārthameva
nahi niraṃśaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ śakyam, anyatrāpi prasaṅgāt
tatkim ? ityāha--mithyā ityādi
tato yathā bhedavyavahārasya mithyātve'pi na saṃvittesat tathā anyatrāpi iti bhāvaḥ
mithyātvam
nanu vijñaptimātre svaparasantānabhedaḥ kṣaṇakṣayādibhedaśca pāramārthika iti cet; atrāha--tatra ityādi
tatra vijñaptimātre svaparasantānāśca kṣaṇakṣayaśca te eva teṣāṃ vā vikalpā bhedāḥ, yadi vā, mānasāḥ pratyayāḥ, teṣāṃ vyavastheyaṃmābhāseta
kutaḥ ? ityāha--avidyātmanaḥ avidyāsvabhāvāt kutaścid vikalpavāsanātaḥ, tatra parasya pramāṇābhāvāt
atra nidarśanamāha— bahirarthāvabhāsavaditi
nidarśanasamarthanamāha--tadarthāsaṃbhave'pi ityādi
jāgradvyāpārādiviplavāt svapnāditadviplava sudatarī tatreva tadvaditi
nanu jāgraddaśāyāṃ sākṣād vyāpārādinirbhāsaḥ, paracetasaḥ śarīrāntare svapne paramparayetyavyabhicāra iti cet; atrāha--pāramparyeṇāpi ityādi
cetanāntarasaṃbhaveniyamaḥ santānāntaracetaneyoḥ sakāśāt saṃbhavasya utpādasya niyamaḥ kuśakāśāvalambanam
kasyāstaniyamaḥ ? ityāha--vyāpāra ityādi
kena prakāreṇa saḥ ? ityāha--na kevalaṃ jāgaraṇe sākṣāttasyāḥ tanniyamaḥ, tadavalambanasvaśarīre'pi niraṃśabuddhivyāpārayoranvayagrahaṇābhāvāt sakalavyāpterasiddheḥ pramāṇavirahāt, svāpādau caitanyābhāve'pi vyāpārādibhāvāt, śālūkādi śālūkādibhyo dṛṣṭāvapi punargomayādeḥ darśanāt saṃbhāvyavyabhicāritvāt, vyāpārapratibhāsasya sarvatrārthapratibhāsavad bhrāntatvāt, api tu pāramparyeṇāpi jāgaraṇe sākṣāt cetanāntaraḥ tasyāstanniyamaḥ svapne pāramparyeṇa buddhereva tadbuddhisaṃbhavāt, tadvibhramastadavalambate uktadoṣeṇa anumānāpravṛtteḥ, śarīraprabhṛteḥ sarvasya bhrāntatvācca
kutaḥ ? ityāha--pratiṣiddhārtha ityādi
pratiṣiddhaḥ saugatena nirākṛto yo'rthaḥ acetano ghaṭādiḥ tasya pratiprasavaḥ pratyujjīvanaṃ tasya prasaṅgāt
etadapi kutaḥ ? ityāha--bahirantabhadād bāhyetarabhedasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ
tathāhi— svavapuṣi buddhivyāpārayoḥ paramārthato yadi kutaścit hetuphalabhāvaḥ pratīyate; vyaktaṃ grāhyagrāhakabhāvaḥ samāpatati
śālūkaḥ vṛścikaḥ
etena vyāptigrahaṇamapi cintitam
vāsanātaḥ sakalaṃ jñānam ityatrāpi nyāyo'yaṃ yojyaḥ
nanu arthaḥ pratibhāsāt sidhyati, sa ca svapne tadabhāve'pi bhavannanaikāntika iti cet; na; vyāpārādirapi tathaiva syāditi doṣāt, tatrāsya pāramparyeṇa paracetasaḥ sabhāvo nārthapratibhāsasya iti kiṃkṛtametat ?
pratibhāsaḥ
arthābhāve'pi
apare manyante--tatrāpi svapnāntikaśarīrasya paramārthato'bhyupagamāt sākṣāt paracetasa eva sa iti; teṣāṃ tatra stambhādipratibhāso'pi satya iti kalpanāpoḍhamabhrāntaṃ pratyakṣam nyāyavi॰ 1
4 iti abhrāntagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ nivarttyābhāvāt, taccharīravat dvicandrāderapi satyatāprāpteḥ
vyavahāreṇa abhrāntagrahaṇamiti cet; na; tenaiva taccharīrasyāpi satyatvopagamāt, vyavahāreṇa paraloka sādhanāt, itarathā kutaḥ pratibhāsādvaitam ? nirālambanāḥ sarve pratyayāḥ pratyayatvāt pra॰ vārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 361 ityatra vā kiṃ vā nidarśanam ? svarūpālambanatve'pi anekāntārthaprati sya baddhasya pratiprasavaprasaṅgaḥ, śarīrādeḥ sāṃśatvena pratibhāsanāt
tato na kiṃcidetat
prajñākaraguptādayaḥ

anyeṣāṃ darśanam--na santānaḥ santānāntaraṃ vā anyatra saṃvṛteḥ iti tadabhāvasādhanaṃ siddhasādhanamiti, teṣāmapyuttaramuktam neha punarucyate, citrajñāne nīlādīnām anyo'nyānanugame santānāntarasiddhiḥ

vijñeyaṃ vidyamānārthavuddhyā'bhāvacatuṣṭayam
kathañcinnānyathā nyāyād buddhiḥ sanmātragocarā || 14
nahi abhāvacatuṣṭayajñānaṃ sarvathā nirviṣayaṃ yuktam, arthāntarālambanopagamāt
saḥ paramāṇuparyantajñānasvarūpaparīkṣāsamaye svarūpamavalambeta nārthabhedam
tadabhāve saṃvidvyapadeśānupapatteḥ
tanna bhāvavyatirekto viśeṣaḥ kvacit kathañcit prameyatāṃ pratipadyeta
vijñeyaṃ paricchedyakem abhāvacatuṣṭayaṃ prāgabhāvādyabhāvacatuṣṭayam
kayā ? vidyamānārthabuddhyā bhāvajñānena
kathaṃcit kenāpi tadutpattiyogyatāprakāreṇa nānyathā buddhyā vijñeyatvābhāvaprakāreṇa vuddhiḥ abhāvacatuṣṭaye iti sambandhaḥ
pratyayādivedanato nyāyāt sanmātragocarī buddhiriti
kārikārthaṃ vivṛṇoti
nahi abhāvacatuṣṭayajñānaṃ sarvathā nirviṣayaṃ viṣayarahitaṃ tucchābhāvagocarameva nahi yuktam
nanu yadyabhāvaviṣayaṃ kathaṃ nirviṣayamucyate iti cet; na; saugatāpekṣayaivamabhidhānāt
sa hi abhāvaṃ necchati
kuto na nirviṣayamiti cet; atrāha--arthāntara ityādi
vivakṣitādarthād anyo'rthaḥ tadantaram tad avalambanaṃ yasya tasya upagamāt saugatena
bhāvāntarasvabhāvatvādabhāvasya

kutaḥ ? ityāha--tadabhāve svarūpāvalambanābhāve saṃvidvyapadeśānupapatteḥ
arthagrahaṇāt jñānasya tadvyapadeśo na svarūpāvalambanāditi cet; nanu arthagrahaṇaṃ buddhiḥ iti kenāvagamyate ? tayaiva buddhyā iti cet; na; svarūpagrahaṇaprasaṅgāt, tadagrahe mamārthagrahaṇam iti pratipattyayogāt
budhyāttayāiti cet; sāpi svarūpasaṃvedanavikalā buddhiḥ iti kathamavagamyate ? ādyajñānārthagrahaṇāt; tadapi kuta iti tadavasthaṃ codyam anavasthā ca
nanvartho yato dṛśyate tajjñānamiti cet; satyam; dṛśyate, nā'svasaṃvedanajñānāt; itarathā parajñānādapi dṛśyeta ityuktam
etena mīmāṃsako'pi kṛtottaraḥ
bhavatu svarūpāvalambanaṃ jñānam, tat svarūpamanyate vyāvṛttamavalambyata iti cet; atrāha--tanna ityādi
tat tasmāt svarūpamavalambeta iti nyāyāt na bhāvavyatirikto jñānasattābhinno na viśeṣo bhedaḥ kvacid vijñāne anyatra vā kathaṃcidekānekādirūpeṇa prameyatāṃ pratipadyeta

antam avasānam atikrānto'ntaḥ sa cāsau bhedaśca viśeṣaḥ nirava sāno viśeṣo'yaṃ pareṇa ucyamānaḥ sanmātrapakṣe samaḥ sadṛśaḥ

kasyāḥ ? ityāha--kṣaṇikasaṃvidaḥ saugatasambandhibuddheḥ
kayoḥ satoḥ ? ityāha--mithyā ityādi
mithyātvam ekānto yasya sa tathoktaḥ sa cāsau vividhaḥ sthūlatvadīrghatvavartulatvādinā citro nirbhāsaśca ghaṭādipratibhāsaḥ tena vidyate pratibhāso darśanaṃ yayoḥ aikyatattvayoḥ niraṃśatvasvasaṃvedanasvarūpayoḥ satoḥ ātmanaḥ kṣaṇikasaṃvidaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati— yathā mithyācetanetaranirbhāsatiraskṛtatvāt na sattāmātrasya nityatvādi svarūpaṃ vā'vabhāsate, tathā sthūlatvādicitrapratibhāsena pratihataprasaratvā na saṃvidātmanorekyatattvayoḥ pratibhāsanamiti

pratipattuḥ puruṣasya yathāsannidhānaṃ sannidhānānatikrameṇa sakalasya śabdarāśeḥ upalambhāśakteḥ kathaṃcit kenāpi niyatadeśādiprakāreṇa kasyacid akārasya anyasya vā śabdātmanaḥ śrutirityevaṃ bruvāṇaṃ mīmāṃsakam
yathā bahiḥparamāṇūnāṃ nīlatāmātrasya antaḥsaṃvedanasya saccetanāderupalambhe'pi sannihitasyāpi na kṣaṇakṣayāderupalambhaḥ tathā akāropalambhe sannihitasyāpītarasya na śrutiḥ pratipattiḥ tathāśakteḥ iti bhāvaḥ
ghakārādeḥ

kutaḥ ? ityāha--tasya tanniyamasya anyathā tadākarṣaṇābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapatteḥ
nanu yaduktam--na bahirabhipretānaṃśakṣaṇikasaṃvidaḥ iti, niyamasya anekāntākarṣaṇāt' iti ca; tanna yuktam; paramāṇubhyo'naṃśakṣaṇikākārasaṃvido'bhāvāt
tanniyamo'pi tatraiva iti cet; atrāha--asaṃbhavāt ityādi
svasya saugatasya iṣṭo'rthaḥ kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇulakṣaṇaḥ tasyā'visaṃvāde saṃpratipattau kriyamāṇāyāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ na pramāṇam sārūpyamasya pramāṇam nyāyabi॰ 1

atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ--tasmādekasya bhāvasya yāvanti pararūpāṇi tāvatyastadapekṣayā tadasaṃbhāvikāryakāraṇastasya tadbhedāt yāvatyaśca vyāvṛttayaḥ tāvatyaḥ śrutayo'tatkāryakāraṇaparihāreṇa vyavahārārthaḥ

anyāpoha
kimarthasya bhāvaḥ kaimarthakyam kasmai prayojanāya iti bhāvaḥ
nanu cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ pratīyate rasanena rasaḥ, evaṃ śeṣendriyeṣvapi vācyam, na ca tatra aparamābhāti, na ca indriyāntaramasti yatra vastvantarapratibhāsaḥ, tato na rūpādibhyaḥ kimapiparaṃ pudgalasvalakṣaṇamekam, tadāha--pratyakṣata ityādi
pratyakṣāt śrotrādijñānād uktavidhinā śabdādisvalakṣaṇabhedapratīteḥ kāraṇādasamānaṃ yathā vikalpena anyato vyavacchedaḥ pratīyate tathā pratyakṣeṇāpi iti asadṛśamiti cet; uttaramāha--na ityādi
yaduktaṃ pareṇa tanna
kutaḥ ? svalakṣaṇasya rūpādiparamāṇulakṣaṇasya avyavaseyatvād aniśceyatvāt
evaṃ manyate yathā cakṣuṣā kevalaṃ rūpaṃ pratīyate nānyātmakaṃ nāppanyā vā na pramāṇāntarāpekṣaṇamasti
svārthānubhavādeva anyasamāropavyavacchedena tattvasiddhiriti cet; atrāha--svārthānubhavasya svaparadarśanasya vyavasāyātmakatopapatteḥ tadapapatteḥ tadapekṣaṇāditi
kiṃbhūtasya ? ityāha— nirjitānyasamāropamanāśca
bhaviṣyati tadanubhavo na ca vyavasāyātmaka iti cet; atrāha--niścaya ityādi
niścayaśca āropamanaśca tayoḥ bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ pareṇa iṣṭaḥ anyathā tadanubhavasya vyavasāyātmakatābhāvaprakāreṇa nopapadyeta na ghaṭeta avikalpānyasamāropamanasorapi bādhyabādhakabhāvopagamāt, tathā ca anubhavagandhādeva naṣṭavyaṃ samāropeṇa iti, na samāropavārttāpi na bhavet
tadapapatteḥ iti punarlikhitamiva bhāti
niścayāropamanasorbādhyabādhakabhāvataḥ

na iti nirarthakamatra

nanu śabdarūpādīnāṃ pudgaladravyadharmatvā'viśeṣe'pi śabdasyaiva grahaṇaṃ na rūpādīnām iti kuto'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ ? tathā, sahopalambhaniyamābhāve'pi ca tādātmyamiti kutaḥ ? iti cet; atrāha--dravyāṇām ityādi

na guṇaistejodravyāderyathānudbhūtavṛttibhiḥ || 16
nahi śabdādīnāmekasāmagryadhīnānāmavinirbhāgavṛttibhājāṃ sahopalambhaniyamābhāve'pi parasparamatādātmyaikāntaḥ paramāṇusthūlākāravat

kvacidubhayopalabdhiḥ udbhūtavṛttereva yathā agniriti

anyato vyāvṛttyā pratibhāsanāt
sakṛt...
dravyāṇām upalambho darśanaṃ guṇaiḥ saha na kevalānām

anena muktidaśāyāṃ viśeṣaguṇarahitasya ātmano'nupalambhaṃ darśayati

ca śabdo bhinnaprakamaḥ, asyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
nānudbhūtavṛttibhiḥ; ata āha--nānudbhūtavṛttibhiḥ
atra nidarśanamāha--yathā ityādi
tejodravyādeḥ ādiśabdena gandhadravyādiparigrahaḥ stotādibhiḥ udbhūtaguṇairupalambha iti udbhūtavṛttiḥnānudbhūtavṛttibhiḥ iti, anena sahopalambhaniyamāt ityasya vyabhicāramāha
vaiśeṣikābhimatasya
upalambhāviṣayatvam
nahi ityādinā etadeva darśayati--śabdā ādiryeṣāṃ rūpādīnāṃ teṣām
kiṃbhūtānām ? ekasāgryadhīnānām avinirbhāgavṛttibhājāsahopalambhaniyamābhāve'pi parasparamatādātmyaikānto bhedaikāntau nahi
keṣāmiva ? ityāha--paramāṇusthūlākāravat
paramāṇavaśca sthūlākāraśca teṣāmiva tadvad iti
sthūlākāropalambhe'pi na tadārambhakaparamāṇūpalambhaḥ tathāpi na tadbhedaikāntaḥ
anena śabdapudgalasya śabdarūpādīnāṃ bhedaikāntasādhane sahopalambhaniyamābhāvasya vyabhicāraṃ darśayati
paramāṇūnāmupalambhada bhāva ityekesthūlākārasya ityapare tatkathaṃ tairvyabhicāro hetoḥ iti; tatrāha--tadanyatarāpāya ityādi
tayoḥ paramāṇusthūlākārayoḥ anyataraḥ, tasyāpāye arthasya ghaṭāderanupapatteḥ tadvat na teṣāmatādātmyaikāntaḥ
tathāhi--sthūlākārāpāye paramāṇava eva, teṣāmanupalambhena asattvam, paramāṇūpāye sthūlākāramātramanavayavaḥ, tathā sati ekadeśacalanādiprasaṅgaḥ
dṛśyāḥ bhaṃgāḥ santi nānya iti cet; tarhi prāgasatāṃ meghādīnāṃ kutaḥ prādurbhāvaḥ ? ahetuka iti cet; sarvaḥ tathā syāditi hetuphalabhāvavilopaḥ
niṣiddho'dvaitādivādaḥ

cārvākāḥ
abhāva iti bauddhāḥ
avayavaśūnyaḥ niraṃśa iti yāvat

tataḥ sūktam--paramāṇusthūlākāravaditi
nanu paramāṇubhyaḥ sthūlamanyadeva, kāraṇāt kāryasya anyatvāt, ataḥ teṣāmapi pakṣīkaraṇāt na tairvyabhicāra iti cet; atrāha--vyatirekaikānte bhedaikānte pṛthaksiddhiprasaṅgāt anyatra laukike deśe avayavānām anyatra avayavinaḥ siddhiḥ upalabdhiḥ pitāputravat, tasyāḥ prasaṅgāt
kutaḥ ? ityāha--sambandhāsiddheḥ samavāyiniṣedhāt
tanna naiyāyikapakṣo yuktaḥ
sāṃkhyapakṣaḥ syāditi cet; atrāha--abhedaikānte paramāṇusthūlākārayoḥ 'ekatvaikārayoḥ, ekatvaikānte sahopalambhaniyamāt kāraṇāt vyartham indriyanānātvam
evaṃ mana paramāṇūpalambhaḥ, tatkathaṃ tadabhedaikāntaḥ ? tathāpi tadupalambhakalpane cakṣuṣā rūpopalambhe rasādīnāmupalambha iti vyarthamindriyanānātvamiti
kathaṃcitpakṣe kuto'yaṃ na doṣa iti cet ? atrāha--kathaṃcittādātmye'pi na kevalaṃ viparyaye rūpādeḥ apiśabdaḥ atrāpi draṣṭavyaḥ, na kevalaṃ paramāṇutadākārayoḥ, sannihitasya sahānupalambhaḥ
kasmin satyapi ? ityāha— tatkaraṇāntarasākalye'pi tatkāraṇaṃ rūpajñānakāraṇaṃ cakṣuḥ tadantaraṃ rasanādiḥ tasya sākalye'pi
kutaḥ ? ityāha--udbhūtaguṇa ityādi
tataḥ sthitam--paramāṇusthūlākāravat iti
yadi vā, śabdādīnāṃ sahopalambhaniyamābhāve parasparam ekasāmagryadhīnānām mābhūtādatādātmyaikāntaḥ śabdopalambhe rūpādyanupalambhāt, abhāvaikāntastu bhavediti cet; atrāha--paramāṇusthūlākāravaditi
sthūlākāropalambhe paramāṇuvat śabdopalambhe rūpādyanupalambhe'pi nābhāvaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ
kutaḥ ? ityāha--tadanyatarāpāye sadā sāvanyataraśca śabdo rūpādi bhrāntasyopāye arthasya cetanasyetarasya vānupapatteḥ

na cāpatyacittaṃ janakacetasi pramāṇam, itaraśrā prakṛtapuruṣasya paracittapratyakṣatā iti vyāhatametat--śarīrapratyakṣatve'pi na buddhiḥ pratyakṣā, buddhivikalpe saṃśayāt ityādi
tathā, samānārthadarśanaikasantāneṣu bhinnā teṣu saṃbhavāttayoḥ

sārūpyaviśeṣaḥ

tathā, pūrvajñānam uttarasya bodharūpatayā janakaṃ na nīlarūpatayā tathā uttaraṃ tathaiva janyathā yathā bodhāt tadrūpatā tathā nīlādapi syāt
arthasya vaiyarthyamiti cet; sārthakatve'pi pūrvadoṣānativṛttiḥ
yadi vā, naikasya nānākārānukaraṇaṃ viruddham ityuktam; kathamanyathā sarvadarśijñānam aśeṣanīlākārānukāri bhavato bhavet ? yadi matam, ādyaṃ nīlajñānaṃ pūrvanīlajñānamantareṇa jātaṃ tanna tasya nīlatā pūrvajñānanīlatākṛtā, tathā anyatrāpi iti; tanna sāram; yataḥ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ hetuphalabhāvāt
tataḥ sthitam--tajjanmasārūpyalakṣaṇaṃ vyabhicaratīti
tadavyavasāyasahitaṃ na tathā iti cet; atrāha--tadadhyavasāyahetutvaṃ ca tasya arthākārajñānasya vyavasāyakāraṇatvaṃ ca vyabhicarati

nanu bhaviṣyadarthaviṣayā buddhirnirviṣayā, tatkāle tadarthasyāsaṃbhavena tatrāpratibhāsanāt, tadasyāḥ kathamavisaṃvāda iti cet ? atrāha--anāgatasya ityādi

nanu bhāvī cet maraṇādiḥ kathaṃ prākpratibhāsagocaraḥ ? prāganutpannaḥ bhāvī ityucyate, anutpannaśca kharaviṣāṇavat na tadgocaraḥ, itarathā na bhāvī, varttamānaghaṭādivat, tato bhaviṣyadarthabuddhirnirviṣayā iti cet; atrāha--akṣa ityādi
akṣaśabdayoḥ kāryabhūte vastujñāne, śabdajñānagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam tena anāgataviṣayam aviśadaṃ sarvaṃ vijñānaṃ gṛhyate
tayoḥ svārthapratipattiṃ prati nāntaraṃ bhedamutprekṣāmahe
evaṃ manyate--yathā bhaviṣyadarthaḥ tadbuddhikāle nāsti, tathā pratyakṣārthaḥ taddeśe nāsti
nahi pratyakṣaparicchedyāḥ arthāḥ sarve tadādhāre ātmani vyavasthitāḥ
ataddeśāḥ paricchidyante nātatkālā iti kiṃkṛto vibhāgaḥ ? bhāvino'pi svakālasattā'niṣedhaḥ, anyathā varttamāno bhavet
so'pi kiṃcidapekṣya bhāvīti

tadanukaraṇe svamatavyāghātāt
dharma...tattvataḥ
paramparayā; nacānarthaviṣayairvikalpaiḥ tattvavyavasthāpanam

kutaḥ ? ityāha--antarbahiḥ ityādi

39 ityādi bhavet

kutaḥ ? ityāha--niścayāpekṣaṃ yato niścaye svasāmānye, itarathā kṣaṇikatvānumānamanarthakameva
tadapekṣamapi svalakṣaṇe pramāṇam; tarhi tadapekṣā yaugaḥ
tannirapekṣameva pramāṇamiti cet; atrāha--sannive ityādi
svalakṣaṇasya yat sannidhānaṃ yacca itaradasannidhānaṃ tābhyāṃ dhiyaḥ pratyakṣabuddheḥ pratibhāsabhidā ca na tadākārāsāna ityarthaḥ
yaugaḥ sannikarṣaḥ yoga eva yaugaḥ
athavā, yaugābhimataḥ sannikarṣaḥ pramāṇaṃ syāditi
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha--sarvataḥ sajātīyād vijātīyād vyāvṛttamapasṛtaṃ vastu gṛhṇadapi pratyakṣam anīlādisamāropaṃ vyavacchinatti yatrāṃśe niścayaṃ janayati ityarthaḥ

sarvadā sthūlapratibhāsādityarthaḥ

vijñaptireva nārthaḥ vijñaptimātraṃ tasminnapi na kevalaṃ bahiḥ, etallakṣaṇam etasya paraparikalpitasvalakṣaṇasya lakṣaṇaṃ darśanaṃ nāpi
nahi jñānaparamāṇavaḥ pratibhānti puruṣavat
sukhādinīlāditattvasya pareṇa pratibhāsa iṣyate
abhyupagame vā nīlādipratibhāsaḥ kimasatya iti cet; anyatra kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? kutaśca tadasatyatā ? grāhyatvenāvabhāsanāt; taimirikopalebdhakeśādivaditi cet; atrāha— svapnādāvityādi
svapna ādiryasya kācakāmalādivibhramasya sa tathoktaḥ tatra tallakṣaṇābhāvaprasaṅgād vijñaptidarśanābhāvaprasaṅgāt nāpi tanmātre'pi tallakṣaṇamiti
ayamabhiprāyaḥ— yathā vibhrame bahirarthābhāvaḥ, pratibhāse'pi tathā svasaṃvedanābhāvo'pi
tatra parasantānasya asato'pi pratibhāsanāt tatra sattve, anyatra kaḥ pradveṣaḥ iti vicāritam
tarhi pratibhāsāviśeṣāt bādhyabādhakabhāvavirahāt jāgraddaśāvata svapnādāvapyartho'sti iti cet; atrāha--sadyapi vidyamāne'pi bāhyārthe svapnādau kathaṃ tadā svapnādikāle cittacaittānāṃ pratyakṣatvaṃ pratyakṣagrāhyatvam ? kathaṃ ca na syāt ? iti paraḥ pṛcchati

hetvantaramāha--tad ityādi

svalakṣaṇopalabdhīnāṃ naikakṣaṇikadarśanam || 27
pratikṣaṇaṃ niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇuṣu pratyakṣeṣu parasparāsamplave kutaścakrabhrāntiḥ ? sā ca bhavantī kathamanekāntasiddhirna bhavet tadupalambhānupalambhayorvirodhāt
bhinnaprakramaḥ apiśabdaḥ, tato na kevalam antarekavikalpavibhramasya api tu spaṣṭasyāpi alātacakrādeḥ vibhramasya vīkṣaṇāt anekāntasiddhiḥ ityupamkāraḥ
nanu pratiparamāṇu pratikṣaṇaṃ saṃvidāṃ bhedāt naikaṃcitram alātacakrajñānamiti cet; atrāha— svalakṣaṇopalabdhīnām ityādi
naikakṣaṇikaparamāṇudarśanaṃ vibhramaḥ atiprasaṅgāt
pratikṣaṇam ityādinākārikārthamāha--kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prati pratikṣaṇam
keṣu ? niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇuṣu pratyekam ekaṃ paramāṇuṃ prati pratyakṣeṣu darśaneṣu parasparāsaṃplave eva citrajñānābhāve kutaḥ cakrabhrāntiḥ na ekaikānudarśanaṃ cakṣudarśanaṃ nāma iti bhāvaḥ
sā ca cakrabhrāntirbhavantī jāyamānā katham anekāntasiddhiḥ anekāntapratītirna bhavet ? bhavedeva
atha aparadeśopasarpiṇām alātakṣaṇānām anyo'nyavivekānupalambhe'pi sarvasādhāraṇabhāsuratāmātradarśanāt cakrabhrāntiriti; tatrāha--tadupalambha ityādi
teṣām alātasvalakṣaṇānāṃ bhāsuratāmātreṇa ya upalambhaḥ yaśca parasparavivekarūpeṇa anupalambhaḥ tayoḥ virodhāt ekasya dṛśyetaratāprāpteḥ anekāntasiddhiriti
ekaikasya ārasya cakrabhāgasya

ityāgamāvisaṃvādi jñānaṃ syādvādaśaṃsanam || 28
